newsitem.title: USA: Marriott to sell hotel to investment trust.
newsitem.headline: Marriott to sell hotel to investment trust.

text.p: Hotel company Marriott International Inc said it planned to sell the first of a series of TownePlace Suites hotels to a real estate investment trust called Lodging Trust USA.
Marriott said it would also sell two additional sites to the newly formed trust, adding that it would still operate the three sites under a long-term agreement with Lodging Trust.
It said construction of the hotel in Newport News, Va, was scheduled to be complete in February.
It did not disclose the terms of the deal.

Marriott said Lodging, which is seeking to make its first public stock offering, would likely get exclusive franchise rights to develop up to 10 additional TownePlace hotels in 10 cities and other areas for a one-year period.
It said TownePlace expected to have 25 hotels open or under construction by the end of 1997.
